h1_usage.question: Do churned and retained customers differ in total product usage (total_usage_count)?
h1_usage.H0: There is no significant difference in mean total usage between retained and churned customers.
h1_usage.H1: There is a significant difference in mean total usage between retained and churned customers.

h2_mrr_plan.question: Do the three plan tiers (Basic, Pro, Enterprise) differ in average MRR?
h2_mrr_plan.H0: The mean MRR is the same across all plan tiers.
h2_mrr_plan.H1: At least one plan tier has a different mean MRR.

h3_satisfaction.question: Do churned customers report lower average support satisfaction scores than retained customers?
h3_satisfaction.H0: There is no significant difference in mean satisfaction score between retained and churned customers.
h3_satisfaction.H1: There is a significant difference in mean satisfaction score between retained and churned customers.
